import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Step 1: Find severely congested road segments (congestion_status = 3) at 2025-10-05 18:00
query = text("""
SELECT hrst.road_segment_id, rs.geometry
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrst.datetime = '2025-10-05 18:00:00'
  AND hrst.congestion_status = 3
""")
severe_congestion = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(f"Number of severely congested road segments: {len(severe_congestion)}")
print(severe_congestion.head(10))

# Step 2: Find the nearest air quality station to any severely congested road segment
# Use ST_Distance to compute minimum distance from each station to all severely congested segments
query = text("""
SELECT aqs.id AS station_id, aqs.name_en,
       MIN(ST_Distance(aqs.coordinate::geography, rs.geometry::geography)) AS min_distance
FROM air_quality_station aqs
CROSS JOIN road_segment rs
WHERE rs.id IN (
    SELECT hrst.road_segment_id
    FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
    WHERE hrst.datetime = '2025-10-05 18:00:00'
      AND hrst.congestion_status = 3
)
GROUP BY aqs.id, aqs.name_en
ORDER BY min_distance
LIMIT 1
""")
nearest_station = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(nearest_station)

# Step 3: Get NO2 reading at Tseung Kwan O (station_id=4) at 2025-10-05 18:00
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, no2, datetime
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 4
  AND datetime = '2025-10-05 18:00:00'
""")
no2_data = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(no2_data)

# Store results
severe_congestion_station_id = int(no2_data['station_id'].values[0])
severe_congestion_station_no2 = float(no2_data['no2'].values[0])
print(f"\nStation ID: {severe_congestion_station_id}")
print(f"NO2: {severe_congestion_station_no2} µg/m³")
